checks.family_of_four: For two adults and two children 17 or under in one stateroom, the terms say the up to 35% discount applies to guests 1 and 2 only, and the children can sail free as the 3rd and 4th guests on select sailings, but they must still pay government fees and taxes. Rates are per person, based on double occupancy, in USD, for US residents on new bookings only (not group bookings). The terms do not mention port charges or onboard service charges (gratuities), and MSC Yacht Club staterooms are excluded. Book by November 2 to be safe: the deals page says the offer ends November 2, while the promotional terms list an expiration of November 5, 2026.
terms: The deals page says "Offer ends November 2" (no year). The promotional terms list the promotion as effective October 20, 2026 and expiring November 5, 2026.
Select sailings; no sailing dates are stated.
Kids 17 and under sail free on select sailings as 3rd and 4th guests and must still pay government fees and taxes. The terms say Kids Sail Free can be withdrawn without notice.
Up to 35% off, applied to the first and second passengers only. Rates are per person, based on double occupancy, in USD. MSC Yacht Club staterooms are excluded.
US residents, new bookings only; not valid for group bookings. Capacity controlled and subject to availability.
The terms say government fees and taxes are included in the price, and that sail-free kids must still pay them. Port charges and onboard service charges are not mentioned.
USD 99 per person for 0 to 4 night sailings, USD 199 for 5 to 14 nights, USD 300 for 15+ nights.
Not combinable with other promotions; one MSC Voyagers Selection, Civil Service, Military, Senior or Interline discount may apply per stateroom.
None shown; the terms say to ask for the "ESCAPE TO SEA CRUISE ONLY" promotion when booking.
unclear: Which sailings carry Kids Sail Free is not listed.
Whether the free 3rd and 4th guests need guests 1 and 2 at a particular fare is not stated.
Port charges and onboard service charges (gratuities) for the children are not mentioned in the promotion terms.
The deals page (November 2) and the promotional terms (November 5, 2026) give different end dates.
before_booking: Price your sailing for all four guests and check that guests 3 and 4 show a free fare before you pay.
Ask for the total government fees and taxes, port charges and onboard service charges for each child.
Book by November 2 if you want this sale, since the two official pages disagree on the end date.
Compare the per-family total with other cruise lines rather than the percentage off.
checks.source_label: MSC Cruises USA promotional terms and conditions
checks.expires_note: the date on MSC's deals page, which gives no year (2026 is our reading); the promotional terms list November 5, 2026

family_value.basis: No family total for a named party and dates was observed on the official site, so savings against the regular price cannot be rated. Kids still pay government fees and taxes.

appeal.fits: Families with children 17 and under as 3rd and 4th guests in one stateroom on select sailings.

links.label: Leaps and Bounds Travel: Up to 35% off cruises + kids sail free

score.who: Families with children 17 and under sharing a stateroom on a qualifying sailing, booking by November 2.
score.why: It covers kids up to 17, but kids still pay government fees and taxes and the qualifying sailings are not listed.

checks.og_card: LEGOLAND Hotel stays with park tickets, breakfast and early park access; non-refundable
checks.title: LEGOLAND California hotel package: kids' tickets from USD 39 a day
checks.headline: Book a LEGOLAND Hotel or LEGOLAND Castle Hotel stay by November 17, 2026 for stays through January 9, 2027, with Park Hopper tickets, daily hot breakfast and early park access; advertised from USD 169 per person per night for a family of four before tax, but reservations are non-refundable and parking is extra.
checks.family_of_four: LEGOLAND's advertised pricing is based on exactly this party: 2 adults and 2 children ages 2 to 12 for a 1-night hotel stay, before tax. The deals page shows a starting price of USD 169 per person per night and kids' tickets from USD 39 per day; these are advertised starting prices, not a quote for your dates. The package includes a Park Hopper ticket (LEGOLAND Theme Park and SEA LIFE Aquarium; multi-day visits must be used within 3 days of the first visit), a daily hot buffet breakfast and early park access. Parking is charged on arrival unless pre-purchased, reservations are non-refundable and full payment is due at booking.
terms: Kids' tickets from USD 39 per day with a hotel stay; from USD 169 per person per night (advertised starting price, based on 2 adults and 2 children ages 2 to 12 for 1 night, tax not included).
November 17, 2026 ("Book by November 17, 2026 and stay through January 9, 2027").
Now through January 9, 2027. All dates are subject to availability and LEGOLAND's discretion; the park is closed on Wednesdays during select seasons.
Pricing is based on 2 children ages 2 to 12. The deals page FAQ says children under 2 get free park admission.
LEGOLAND Hotel and LEGOLAND Castle Hotel (see the partner-hotel conflict below).
Park Hopper ticket for LEGOLAND Theme Park and SEA LIFE Aquarium, daily hot buffet breakfast and early park access (start time not stated).
Tax (not included in advertised prices) and parking (charged on arrival unless pre-purchased with the booking).
Reservations are non-refundable; full payment is due at booking. Optional trip protection is offered.
Cannot be combined with any other offers, discounts, promotions or group rates. The offer page says new bookings only and not valid through third-party websites.
unclear: How many ticket days come with each night of the stay is not stated.

Partner hotels conflict: the package page lists Hopper tickets, early access and breakfast at select partner hotels, while the kids' tickets offer page says the hotel offer is not valid for partner hotels.
No blockout dates are listed; LEGOLAND says dates are subject to availability and blockout dates may be added at any time.
No minimum stay is stated, and the early park access start time is not given.
The basis of the from-USD 39 per day kids' ticket price inside the package (ticket type, party, number of days) is not stated.
A separate ticket-only kids' offer (from USD 39 with an adult Hopper ticket) ends November 1, 2026; this check covers only the hotel package.
before_booking: Price your exact dates for your real party and children's ages, and check the kids' ticket price per day at checkout.
Add tax and parking to the quoted price.
Book the LEGOLAND Hotel or LEGOLAND Castle Hotel directly if you want the package benefits; partner-hotel terms conflict.
Check for Wednesday park closures on your dates.
Book only when your dates are firm: reservations are non-refundable.
checks.source_label: LEGOLAND California Hotel + Ticket Package page

family_value.basis: No family total for a named party and dates was observed on the official site, so savings against the regular price cannot be rated. The advertised from-price is a starting price for 2 adults and 2 children, not a quote for named dates.

score.who: Families with young children (the advertised price assumes ages 2 to 12) planning a LEGOLAND California visit through January 9, 2027 who are fine with a non-refundable booking.
score.why: Tickets, breakfast and early access are bundled, but reservations are non-refundable, parking is extra and the starting price is not a quote for your dates.

checks.og_card: Bahamas resort: up to 35% off 4+ nights and a $250 resort credit; a 21% charge and resort fee are added
checks.title: Atlantis Bahamas Fall Into Paradise: up to 35% off 4+ nights, USD 250 resort credit
checks.headline: Book a 4+ night Atlantis stay by November 22 for travel through January 31, 2027 and save up to 35%, with a USD 250 per-room resort credit, daily breakfast for two and kids 5 and under eating free at select venues; Thanksgiving week and mid-December to January 1 are blacked out, and a 21% charge, a daily resort fee and mandatory gratuities are added.
checks.family_of_four: For 2 adults and 2 children, the free daily buffet breakfast covers two people only (a folio credit valued up to USD 100 a day), so the children's breakfasts are extra unless a child is 5 or under and eats a kids' entrée free at a participating venue alongside an adult ordering a full-priced entrée (the Kids Eat Free page lists guests of The Coral, The Royal, The Reef and The Cove; Harborside is not listed). The USD 250 resort credit is per room, per stay and can pay for Atlantis Kids Adventures, Dolphin & Marine Adventures or Atlantis food and beverage outlets, but not taxes, gratuities or retail. Atlantis lists mandatory gratuities per person, per night for guests 12 and older, so the amount depends on your children's ages. "Up to 35%" is a maximum; the page does not say which rooms or dates get it.
terms: "Save up to 35% on 4+ Nights" plus a USD 250 resort credit and daily breakfast for two.
November 22 ("Book by: November 22 | Travel by: January 31, 2027"; no year is given for the booking date).
Travel by January 31, 2027; the resort credit applies to travel from October 16, 2026 to January 31, 2027.
November 21 to 27, 2026 and mid-December 2026 to January 1, 2027 (the page gives December 15 in one place and December 16 in another).
4 nights. The resort credit and the breakfast both require a 4+ night stay; new reservations only.
The Coral, The Royal, The Cove, The Reef and Harborside.

Kids 5 and under eat free at select participating venues: a free child's entrée from the kids' menu when at least one adult orders a full-priced adult entrée, settled by room charge, for registered guests of The Coral, The Royal, The Reef and The Cove (separate Kids Eat Free page). Mandatory gratuities apply to guests 12 and older. No other child terms are stated.

USD 250 per room, per stay; usable for Dolphin & Marine Adventures, Atlantis Kids Adventures, CRUSH, Lost City Escape Room, Good Lies and Atlantis food and beverage outlets. Not for the spa, golf, casino, Atlantis LIVE performances, retail shops, laundry, gratuities, taxes or Energy Surcharges. No cash value; unused amounts are lost.
Daily buffet breakfast for two at most Atlantis dining outlets, valued up to USD 100 a day including 10% VAT and 15% gratuities, credited to the room folio.

A 21% charge on the nightly room rate (VAT and levies); a daily resort fee of USD 77.00 including VAT at The Coral and The Royal, USD 82.50 at The Cove and The Reef; mandatory gratuities for guests 12 and older of up to USD 14 per person per night at The Coral and The Royal, up to USD 30 at The Cove and up to USD 52 at The Reef; at Harborside, a USD 20.52 per person daily utility service fee and USD 6.25 per person daily gratuities (12 and older). All subject to change.
Not combinable with other offers; not valid for group or casino bookings; combinable with luxury consortia amenities.
unclear: The booking deadline has no year; we read it as November 22, 2026, because travel runs to January 31, 2027.
Which room types, hotels or dates get the full 35% is not stated; "up to" is a maximum.
The December blackout start conflicts on the page: December 15 in one place, December 16 in another.
Whether the resort fee is charged per room or per person is not stated in the lines we read, and cancellation and deposit rules sit in general terms we did not read.
The footnote to "Kids 5 & Under Eat Free at Select Participating Venues" is not shown on the offer page; the separate Kids Eat Free page gives the adult-entrée condition.
before_booking: Price your exact dates for your real party and room on the official site, and confirm how much of the 35% your dates actually get.
Avoid November 21 to 27 and December 15 to January 1, or confirm the blackout dates directly.
Add the 21% charge, the daily resort fee and mandatory gratuities for everyone 12 and older to the quoted price.
Budget breakfast for the children: the free breakfast covers two people.
Read the cancellation and deposit terms before you pay.
